lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: The high-luminance circular spots are arranged in approximately 10-12 discernible vertical columns and 6-7 horizontal rows across the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the gill slits. The spots exhibit peak pixel intensity in the central columns and decrease in size and luminance towards the ventral boundary.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance are visible intersecting with the horizontal rows of spots, most prominent in the region immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit, forming a rectangular grid-like pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary longitudinal ridges are visible running horizontally across the upper flank. They are characterized by a sharp pixel intensity gradient, with high-luminance dorsal-facing edges and high-contrast shadows on their ventral-facing sides.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct irregular notch is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the pectoral fin, approximately one-third of the distance from the fin base.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple commensal fish (remoras) are visible attached to the lateral flank, including one prominent individual near the dorsal ridge and another beneath the pectoral fin.
